cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sign beside 'I support the extension,' please. A tick without a name won't survive an objection.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like it, but I'd rather not put my name down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I can't submit that as support. It has to identify someone other than me. Full name, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Print your full name in the key underneath. Underneath, please, not on the back where the committee won't see it.

reason: Make professional scrutiny and placement instructions the method for obtaining visible endorsement; keep B initials compromise causal.
